prompts.video:
Warm golden look, natural light, crumbs and flaky pastry in macro detail, handheld intimate framing. A 5-second vertical mobile video ad for Tartine Bakery in three shots. No on-screen text, captions, subtitles, logos, signs or readable words.
SHOT ONE (0-2s): a surfer in her thirties in a dripping black wetsuit, board under her arm, Ocean Beach, gray surf and a long empty shoreline, a vintage camper van parked on the Great Highway, 6:30 AM, cold fog, pale light. she jogs out of cold gray surf, shivering, peels down her wetsuit hood.
HARD CUT. SHOT TWO (2-4s): wrapped in a towel on the back bumper of the van, she opens a warm paper bag. a hand tears open a caramelized, orange-zested morning bun, sugar glistening, steam curling off it, a dark-crusted round country loaf behind it.
HARD CUT. SHOT THREE (4-5s): she bites into the morning bun, eyes closed, sugar on her lips, waves rolling behind her.
AUDIO: Music: reverb-drenched surf rock guitar, slow and dreamy, resolving in shot three and ending with a warm three-note acoustic guitar figure on the final frame. Sound effects: a crackling crust, a paper bag rustling open. Voiceover by a laid-back, warm female voice, American English, in English. At 0 seconds the narrator says: "Fifty-five degree water. Worth it."
